findings.what: The R4 fix runs 'npm --prefix ... exec -- playwright test --config playwright.config.ts' from the repo root, which has no playwright.config.ts. It still fails as printed.
findings.why: The fix only half works. Outside workspace mode, npm exec takes the binary from the prefix's node_modules/.bin, so the pinned 1.62.0 is used and that part of R4 is closed. It still runs the command in the caller's directory (runPath = process.cwd()), not in the prefix. So '--config playwright.config.ts' resolves to <root>/playwright.config.ts. The U10 export has none: the only one is src/Uinsure.Policies.Web/playwright.config.ts (testDir '../../tests/...'). The same applies to the new R3 line '... --reporter=html --trace on' and then 'exec -- playwright show-report'. The HTML reporter writes playwright-report next to the config, while show-report looks in the caller's directory. MAN-6 has the same problem: 'exec -- vitest --config vite.config.ts' and the '../../tests/Uinsure.Policies.Web.Tests/unit/client/wb-1.test.ts' filter are both relative to the root, not to the web project. 'exec -- playwright install chromium' and the troubleshooting row are fine, because they take no path. This is static evidence and none of it was run, but it meets David's P1 bar: a printed command that fails as printed. The same lines are in build.mjs at lines 39, 40 and 45.
